blindspots.text: No automated pixel diff. Design % is a judgement, not a measurement. Fix: a Playwright job that renders each route at its declared widths × EN/AR, diffs against the .dc.html, and writes the score back here.
Codex cannot reach this board. It must either edit status/saqeel-status.json in the repo worktree or end every task with a status-update block that gets pasted into Claude Design.
Two writers, one file. Claude Code and Codex can clobber each other. Rule: one card per edit, never rewrite the whole file, always bump revision + updated.
Nothing is committed on feature/ipad-field-channel-delivery (~60 files). Any percentage here can vanish on a branch reset.
Three competing stylesheets in the repo (astryx.css, saqeel-components.css, v2-components.css + a legacy file). Until one is named authority, 'matches the design' is ambiguous.
.dc.html files are prototypes, not route maps — one design page can cover several routes and vice versa. The route field is the only join key.
No test-evidence lane. web/e2e specs exist but their pass/fail is not surfaced, so 'wired' is not 'verified'.
PWA breakage is only visible where a card declares it. An undeclared token, instrument-version or tab-route change can break the iPad app silently.
The PWA runs inside the same Next app under /field, not as a separate deployable. An install/offline regression in the web build breaks the field channel with no separate signal.
